children: has established a subsidiary in Vietnam, according to a newly published business registration filing reviewed by Reuters, marking its formal entry into one of Southeast Asia's faster-growing electric vehicle markets. Tesla shares were down 1.57% premarket.

Tesla Motors Vietnam Limited Liability Company was registered in Ho Chi Minh City on September 11 with charter capital of 77.667 billion dong ($3 million). The licence covers wholesale and retail sales of automobiles, vehicle parts, machinery and equipment, alongside import, export and distribution.

David Jon Feinstein, a US national with an Austin address, is listed as chairman. Isabel Ching Fan is general director and Nguyen Manh Hung her assistant. Tesla didn't respond to a request for comment from Reuters.

title: Tesla Files to Enter Vietnam's EV Market
